name: Alon Weinberg
biography: Alon Weinberg is a security researcher at Deep Instinct. Prior to joining Deep Instinct two years ago, Alon served in the IDF for 4.5 years in an elite cyber unit as a security researcher. As part of his role in Deep Instinct, Alon is in charge of finding new ways to enhance and develop protection and defense mechanisms. Alon leverages his experience in offensive operations, OS internals and programming to explore attack surfaces in Windows and macOS, analyze malware and research attack vectors and evasion techniques. Alon is a cross-fit junky and enjoys riding his motorcycle whenever his training routine allows it. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/alon-weinberg-2a7742142/
